about: A copy of the standard shared record list (sce:std/shared/record_list.scxml) run with no Mesh router (`router` false: the driver gives it none), as on one device whose host attached no link. Every send to a peer is refused where it is made, as error.execution, and each change the copy makes is taken in all the same, because what a copy does to itself is queued before anything is sent to a peer (docs/adr/0046, section 4): a person writing over a value holds the new one, and a hub that cannot tell its people of a settled instant settles itself. Expected values come from a model of the list, not from a backend.

steps.note: started with no Mesh router: every send to a peer is refused where it is made
the host names the copy: node 1, a person's copy, which has no route to its hub
a person's change is taken in here although the send to the hub fails
a change over the field writes over the value it saw and holds the new one: the write is queued before the send to the hub that fails
another field of the row is written beside it
the host names the same copy the hub, node 9: a list on one device with no route to its people
the host asks the hub to settle up to an instant with one member: its clock moves past it, and the question to the people is refused where it is made
a member answers with what the hub holds: the instant is settled, and the hub forgets its tombstones up to it, though it cannot tell its people
